nodes.description: Mapping of role => RoleData holding members and adminRole; the access control authority store.
Mapping of proposalId => Proposal, holds targets, values, votes and execution state.
Total number of proposals ever created; used as next proposal id.
Address of the governance strategy used to compute voting and proposition power.
Delay in blocks before a newly created proposal can be voted on.
Mapping of addresses permitted to execute governance proposals.
Admin (governance) address permitted to queue/cancel/execute transactions.
Timelock delay in seconds between queueing and execution.
Mapping of actionHash => bool marking transactions queued for execution.
Mapping of actionHash => bool marking transactions unlocked for early priority execution.
Mapping of address => bool designating priority controllers.
Mapping of user => cumulative tokens already claimed from the Merkle distributor.
The currently active Merkle root, epoch and IPFS CID.
Oracle contract providing new Merkle root data.
Creates and stores a new governance proposal; validates executor and creator power.
Cancels a proposal if the creator lost proposition power; loops over executor cancellations.
Queues a succeeded proposal, computing executionTime from block.timestamp plus executor delay.
Executes a queued proposal by forwarding every action to the timelock executor.
Lets msg.sender cast a vote on a proposal.
Registers an off-chain signature vote by recovering the EIP-712 signer with ecrecover.
Internal vote recorder: reads voting power and accumulates for/against votes.
Grants a role to an account, gated by the role's admin role.
Revokes a role from an account, gated by the role's admin role.
Lets an account renounce its own role; requires account == msg.sender.
Executes a queued action after delay/grace/priority checks using low-level call or delegatecall.
Queues an action, requiring executionTime >= block.timestamp + delay.
Priority controller locks/unlocks a queued action for execution in the priority window.
External non-reentrant claim of rewards for msg.sender via Merkle proof.
Claims rewards for another user; gated by CLAIM_OPERATOR_ROLE or user allowlist.
Verifies Merkle proof, records claimed amount and transfers reward tokens to the user.
Borrows voting tokens, submits a governance vote, then returns the tokens.
Borrows tokens and submits a signature-based vote before returning tokens.
Borrows proposition tokens, creates a proposal, then returns the tokens.
Stores the oracle-proposed Merkle root and starts the waiting period using block.timestamp.
Activates the proposed root once the waiting period has elapsed and updates are not paused.
Owner-only setter for the governance strategy address.
Owner-only setter for the voting delay.
ADD_EXECUTOR_ROLE-only function that allowlists executor addresses.
OWNER_ROLE-only function that removes executor addresses.
Internal setter of a role's admin role; rewrites authority relationships.
Caller-controlled address used as voter, creator, claimant and admin checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for delays, waiting periods and grace periods.
Original transaction sender; a phishing/authorization hazard if used for access control.
Low-level call forwarding ETH to a proposal-configured target.
Delegatecall into a proposal-configured target executing in executor storage context.
External call from governor into the timelock executor during execute/cancel loops.
Token pull from MINTER in the flash-loan style helpers.
Recovers a signer address from an EIP-712 signature; basis of vote/authorization.
Token transfer out of the rewards treasury to a user during claims.
Privilege-granting state write to the access control role mapping.
Proposal identifier supplied by the caller.
bytes32 role identifier for grant/revoke/check operations.
Account address receiving or losing a role.
ExecutorWithTimelock used to validate and run the proposal.
Array of target addresses of the proposal transactions.
Voting power fetched from the strategy for the voter at the proposal start block.
Address recovered from ecrecover in off-chain signature vote.
keccak256 hash identifying a queued timelock action.
Timestamp at which a queued action may be executed.
Storage pointer to the proposal being created.

edges.reason: create stores msg.sender as the proposal creator.
create writes the new proposal into _proposals.
create increments _proposalsCount after storing the proposal.
cancel loops external cancelTransaction calls on the executor.
queue derives executionTime from block.timestamp plus executor delay.
queue reads and updates the stored proposal executionTime.
execute forwards every action to the executor via an external call.
submitVote delegates vote recording to _submitVote.
msg.sender is passed to _submitVote as the voter.
submitVoteBySignature recovers the voter with ecrecover.
The recovered signer address becomes the voting account.
_submitVote adds voting power to forVotes or againstVotes.
_submitVote reads proposal strategy indirectly tied to role-gated state.
grantRole writes the role membership mapping after the admin check.
grantRole reads _roles to enforce the admin role requirement.
_setRoleAdmin rewrites the admin of a role in _roles.
revokeRole mutates role membership in _roles.
renounceRole requires account == msg.sender.
claimRewards delegates to _claimRewards for msg.sender.
claimRewardsFor checks CLAIM_OPERATOR_ROLE against msg.sender.
_claimRewards updates _CLAIMED_ before transferring tokens.
_claimRewards transfers reward tokens from the treasury to the user.
setTransactionPriorityStatus flips the priority unlock flag for an action.
executeTransaction clears the queued flag before performing the call.
executeTransaction performs a low-level value call to the target.
executeTransaction can delegatecall the target in executor context.
executeTransaction enforces timelock, grace and priority windows with block.timestamp.
queueTransaction records the action hash as queued.
queueTransaction requires executionTime >= block.timestamp + delay.
flashVote pulls and returns voting tokens around a governance vote.
flashVote calls GOV.submitVote while holding borrowed tokens.
flashVotePermit pulls and returns voting tokens around a signature vote.
flashVotePermit calls GOV.submitVoteBySignature while holding borrowed tokens.
flashProposal pulls and returns proposition tokens around proposal creation.
flashProposal calls GOV.create while holding borrowed tokens.
proposeRoot starts the waiting period from block.timestamp.
updateRoot requires block.timestamp >= waiting period end.
updateRoot writes the pending root into the active root.
OWNER_ROLE-gated setter updates the governance strategy.
OWNER_ROLE-gated setter updates the voting delay.
authorizeExecutors marks addresses as authorized executors.
unauthorizeExecutors clears authorized executor flags.
proposalId parameter selects the proposal to queue.
role parameter selects the role to grant.
account parameter is the grantee of the role.
executor parameter is used for validation and stored in the proposal.
targets parameter is stored in the proposal for later execution.
votingPower is accumulated into forVotes/againstVotes inside _submitVote.
signer local stores the ecrecover output before being used as voter.
actionHash identifies the queued action for execution and cancellation.
executionTime is computed from block.timestamp in queue.
newProposal is the storage pointer populated in create.

normalization_plan.reason: param.proposalId is a caller-supplied parameter consumed directly by the queue function.
param.role is the role identifier consumed directly by grantRole.
param.account is the grantee address consumed directly by grantRole.
param.executor is validated and stored by the create function.
param.targets is stored by the create function for future execution.
local.votingPower is produced inside _submitVote from the strategy lookup.
local.signer is the direct return value of the ecrecover unsafe operation.
local.actionHash is the identifier used by executeTransaction.
local.executionTime is computed inside the queue function from block.timestamp.
local.newProposal is the storage pointer to the proposal built in create.
